title: Immersive Tuapse Overhaul
description: Visual adjustments, mob overhaul, RPG systems
body: Weather effects have been added, and rain has been overhauled with updated visuals and sound. The inventory visuals have been reworked, down to the particles of moved items. Combat system animations have been changed, and classes and relics from the RPG Series have been added.With the RPG Series addons for structures and additional structures in the world, there is plenty to explore. Enemy behavior has also been overhauled; they will now pay attention to light and sound and converge on their sources. Spider behavior has been changed—they now cluster together and primarily try to attack you with webs from a distance.
